title: Monash Open Analytics Lab
text:
Faculty
Monash Econometrics and Business Statistics Department has more than 40 permanent academics, and another 50 research students and post-doctoral researchers, with most pursuing research in data analytics, including open source software development. Here is just a sample of the work our academics and PhD students are involved in.

Professor Rob Hyndman
World leading expert in forecasting and time series modelling.


Dr Jessica Leung
Research at the intersection of mathematical optimisation, data mining and statistics.
Click here to see a full list of our staff and their research interests.

title: Monash Open Analytics Lab
text:
Students



July 2025 network map of the EBS PhD students and their supervisors


A few highlights of student research are:

Krisanat Anukarnsakulchularp
Spatiotemporal network visualisation and modelling with applications to health data.


Bets Ruscoe
Studying AI Ethics and deep learning models


Cash Looi
Looking at high-dimensional inference, and flexible multinomial choice modeling.
Click here for a more extensive list of our PhD students and their research interests

title: Monash Open Analytics Lab
text: We develop open-source analytical tools, promote transparent and reproducible practices, deliver training that builds capability, and forge global partnerships that help government, industry, and communities make better decisions.

title: Monash Open Analytics Lab
section: Guiding Better decisions - What we do
text:
Guiding Better decisions - What we do
We use data to support evidence-based decisions on the big challenges - climate, health, and thriving societies.

Open tools - What we build
Open-source software, workflows and data resources, so that others can access, reuse, and improve.

title: Monash Open Analytics Lab
text:
Transparent methods - How we work
Open source software and workflows, reproducible and auditable analytics that others can access, reuse and improve, leading to trustworthy, ethical, and accountable science.
